verdict.rationale: Activepieces ships both a built-in MCP server (docs-4, docs-27) letting external MCP clients like Claude/Cursor drive flows, and an explicit embeddable MCP feature (docs-13, docs-35) that lets end users expose their own workflows/automations as MCP tools callable by an external agent via an Authorize flow. This directly matches the story of exposing workflows/app actions as MCP tools for external agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP tool-exposure flow and more detail on which specific actions/tools are exposed vs whole flows.
